title: Counter-Selector Wave 02: artifact readiness and acquisition routing
purpose: Audit whether the thirty source-routed denominator objects contain qualifying work artifacts for blind-first review, refuse to treat K0 routing records as operator artifacts, and produce a balanced acquisition queue for every missing object.
audit_unit: one source-routed Counter-Selector object plus its K0 custody route and matched control

required: bounded work object, decision record, correction object, or failure ledger
observable state transition or attempted transition
limits, missing receipts, and a recoverable falsifier

artifact_requirements: contemporaneous work product or warning object
provenance showing who produced or transmitted the object
recipient, decision surface, or downstream user receipt
before-and-after state or attempted state transition
independent custody or a source-addressable copy
class_rules.next_action: Acquire the underlying work product and recipient-state receipt before blind review.

artifact_requirements: original allegation, claim, or work object
evidence that would reverse the control disposition
custody sufficient to compare claim and outcome
class_rules.next_action: Acquire both the original claim object and the merits record so the control cannot be reduced to a label.
Acquire one bounded specialist object with requirements, result, limits, and handoff evidence.

artifact_requirements: work product separable from title or appointment
support, staff, and institutional access ledger
class_rules.next_action: Acquire a title-independent work object and support ledger before using the operator as a comparator.

artifact_requirements: standing, custody, or relationship state after correction
observed use rather than policy existence alone
class_rules.next_action: Acquire an observed contradiction-to-correction sequence; architecture alone remains a control, not a partnership result.

artifact_requirements: contradiction, changed requirement, or disputed custody event
attempted repair, refusal, or explanation mutation
counterfactual showing what successful repair would require
class_rules.next_action: Acquire the pre-failure object, contradiction, propagation record, and final custody state.
